tool_description: CarinaNet is a deep learning model that automatically detects the carina and endotracheal tube tip in chest X-rays to assist in evaluating tube placement.
tool_author: Alice Heiman, Xiaoman Zhang, Emma Chen, Sung Eun Kim, Pranav Rajpurkar
demo_commands:
import carinanet
result = carinanet.predict_carina_ett('chest_xray.jpg')
print('Carina:', result.get('carina'))
print('ETT:', result.get('ett'))
import carinanet
model = carinanet.CarinaNetModel()
result = model.predict('chest_xray.jpg')
print('Carina:', result.get('carina'))
print('ETT:', result.get('ett'))

image_path.description: Path to the input chest X-ray image file (DICOM, PNG, JPEG, or TIFF format).

carina.description: Detected carina coordinates or location information.

ett.description: Detected endotracheal tube coordinates or location information.

reference: @article{heiman2025factchexcker, title={FactCheXcker: Reducing Hallucinated Measurements in AI Radiology Systems}, author={Heiman, Alice and Zhang, Xiaoman and Chen, Emma and Kim, Sung Eun and Rajpurkar, Pranav}, journal={Radiology AI}, year={2025}}
